# SC2015: cross-module-scoped-dependency

## Meaning

The compiler emitted this diagnostic for cross module scoped dependency. The declaration or generated contract violates a statically checkable SupaCloud rule.

## Fix

Keep request/job providers in their owning feature. Export an application-scoped port and pass request/job data explicitly across features.

## Reproduction

Place the example below in a focused compiler fixture and assert that `SC2015` is reported with a file location. The fixture must fail before the fix and pass after it.

## Failing Example

```ts
// Expected diagnostic: SC2015
@Injectable({ scope: "request" }) class RequestValue {}
@Module({ name: "other", providers: [RequestValue], exports: [RequestValue] }) class Other {}
@Controller("/") class View { constructor(readonly value: RequestValue) {} }
@Module({ name: "feature", imports: [Other], controllers: [View] }) class Feature {}
```
